protocol.hypothesis: Returning image observations of the same camera-mapped gate correct gate-relative position and velocity without resetting the joint estimator.
estimator_inputs: known camera intrinsics/mount and 1.5m nominal gate size
protocol.gate_map: Four static corners from multi-frame camera/IMU initialization; never native geometry.
protocol.intentional_gate_gap: No gate constraints until one physical second of joint motor feedback; continue background and IMU through the gap.
protocol.association: Require four red edge supports. Refine around the predicted gate, then search image apertures if needed. Retain original 1px PnP, 0.5 IoU and 40px side admission checks.
protocol.ablation: Causal gate-off numerical replay using identical background tracks and IMU edges; own fitted states, depths and prediction history. This is conditional on the actual flown trajectory.
protocol.promotion: Five unchanged live trials across the declared offsets; report paired gate-on/off RMS across all trials, including any failures.
protocol.raw_retention: 128MiB temporary trace cap; remove raw data after scoring/replay. Keep compact optimizer inputs and short clips.
development_already_observed: diagnostic-01: background tracks lost while braking
development-04: stale IMU before joint takeover
protocol.checkpoint_claim: Separate staying within bounds from recovery: record whether error was already within bounds before observations returned.
protocol.improvement_claim: Require aggregate paired position and velocity RMS to improve before claiming both improved.
protocol.startup_failures: Retain all attempts; retry at most once if no flight trace/score was produced and native setup timed out.
protocol.gate_evidence: Retain first and most recent accepted gate view, in addition to the current five-frame window and camera-derived position anchor; at most eight states.
protocol.gate_cadence: Valid returning-gate measurements can trigger a fit after 50ms; background-only updates retain the 150ms interval.
protocol.scoring_fix: Ignore unpaired capture-view events; required controller image identities still require a complete render/readback timing match.
protocol.previous_batch: retained/live-01 passed; retained/live-02 is unscored due to capture-parser KeyError. Preserve both; do not infer a flight pass from the unscored attempt.

command: python -m target.aigp.experiments.camera_imu joint OUTPUT --shift OFFSET --joint-init reprojection --gate-return

controller_error.message: joint estimator lost its background tracks
controller returned a command for stale IMU telemetry

accepted_claim: Five unchanged native slow turns passed the declared return-observation bounds across lateral offsets -0.5 to +0.5m. Camera/IMU estimates drove motor feedback. Retained gate views preserved corrections after observations stopped. Aggregate position and velocity RMS improved against a causal replay with gate residuals disabled.
observation: The recent window forgot gate constraints after dropout. Retaining first/latest measured gate views preserves their information while the state and depth fit continue.
limitations: One known gate, one slow turn direction, five controlled starts. Gate-off results are causal numerical replays on the actual flown trajectory. Some estimates were within bounds before the gate returned; those are not large-error recoveries. No map growth, online IMU bias estimation, completed gate passage, course-completion or standard-interface qualification claim.
next_checkpoint: Add replacement background landmarks before old tracks disappear, then pass two gates with one continuous camera/IMU estimate.
